variant.briefing:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Guess some companies see danger when offered a run in Pyro. We see profits. Got one here that starts in the system at [Location] and then goes to [Destination].  

The client warned us that outlaws in Pyro regularly target this run, which has scared other hauling concerns. Be sure your ship is all geared up and can hold [MissionMaxSCUSize] cargo containers. And don't forget to bring a handheld tractor beam.
